import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long[][] a = new long[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = sc.nextLong();
            }
        }
        long MOD = 1000000007L;
        long result = 0;
        int maxMask = 1 << n;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < maxMask; mask++) {
            long prod = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                long val = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        val = (val * a[j][i]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        val = (val * ((MOD + 1 - a[j][i]) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                prod = (prod * val) % MOD;
            }
            result = (result + prod) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
